messages:
Jun Park: handing off primary in ~10m — leaving the active pager context here so whoever picks up has everything. Current active pager: kvcache-thrash (pager #5432) affecting us-east-1 hosted inference. Symptom: p99 token latency spikes and ~5-10% 500s for /v1/generate streams. Customer impact: subset of high-throughput customers seeing timeouts and degraded throughputs. Incident bot below.

PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT triggered -> #5432 kvcache-thrash (P2). Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345. Trigger: p99 > 2.5s, error-rate > 5% over 5m.

OpsBot: short summary + runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-thrash — follow steps 1-4 under 'fast mitigation'. Key metrics: redwood.kvcache.latency.p99, redwood.kvcache.errors.rate, redwood.kvcache.hit_rate.

Aisha Khan: I'm primary until 02:00 UTC. Samir is secondary. Immediate plan:
- Lock in mitigation: restart kvcache pods in us-east and monitor hit_rate.
- If errors don't drop in 5m, scale cache nodes + enable short-term bypass for low-latency routes.
- Notify customer success if any workspace >10% error.

Jun Park: notes on quick commands (copy/paste):
```
# check autoscaler + pods
kubectl -n redwood get hpa,kend,pods -l app=kvcache -o wide --context=prod-us-east
# restart deployment
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/kvcache-us-east --context=prod-us-east
# quick scale helper
./tools/scale_cache.sh --region us-east --add 2 --reason "oncall emergency"
```

Samir Patel: I'll take the pager if Aisha needs a break. Two quick things to call out:
- Watch prefix hit-rate metric: grafana/dashboard/kvcache -> set alert to 15% drop.
- If restarting causes cold-cache storms, enable gradual restart: set env KVCACHE_DRAIN=1 on new pods.

Rebecca Li: Customer impact assessment: I've flagged this incident to CS and added a short note to the incident doc. If we see >15% user-facing errors or SLA misses, escalate to P1 and page eng-sre. CC list: @platform-ops, @customer-success.

OpsBot: Runbook quick pointers (short):
- Step A: Rolling restart with 30s between pods
- Step B: Scale up nodepool by +2, wait until ready
- Step C: If persistent, cut traffic to fallback model for affected routes: Console -> Routes -> set fallback=true

Jun Park: Handoff checklist (brief):
- Active pager: #5432 attached
- Current mitigations: restart triggered at t+2m by Aisha
- Open tasks: monitor error-rate, watch for cold-cache spikes, scale if errors > 6%
- Escalation: page eng-sre + ops-lead if customer impact >10% for 10m

Aisha Khan: Started restart now :white_check_mark: Watching metrics at https://grafana.redwood/d/kvcache/us-east

Samir Patel: standing by. If Aisha needs me to flip fallback routes I can do so in console. Also logging commands to incident doc.

Jun Park: Thanks — I'll pick up after Aisha's shift. If anything changes escalate to eng-sre immediately. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Incident summary appended to https://intra.redwood/incidents/5432

Rebecca Li: leaving an update for CS and marking stakeholders. Good handoff everyone.

Aisha Khan: handing back to Jun in 8m. Jun: you have primary after me. Samir will remain secondary.

Jun Park: got it, taking primary when Aisha signs off. Ping me on-thread and @me on PD if it spikes.

(end)
